en: Dependent on a state that is both with taints (*sāsava*) and wholesome (*kusala*), a state that is neither without taints (*anāsava*) nor wholesome arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is without taints and wholesome, a state that is neither without taints nor wholesome arises by way of the root condition….
Under the root condition there are two [answers] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigatapaccaya*) there are two.

Dependent on a state that is both with-outflows (sāsava) and unwholesome (akusala), a state that is neither-with-outflows nor unwholesome arises by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya). Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.

Dependent on a state that is with-outflows and indeterminate (abyākata), a state that is neither-with-outflows nor indeterminate arises by way of root-condition. ... Under root [condition], two; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], two.
